name: Following Up After a Meeting or Interview
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on following up after a meeting or interview -- practice these key phrases out loud:
Thank you for taking the time to meet with me today.
I really enjoyed learning more about the role and the team.
Please let me know if you need anything further from my end.
Looking forward to hearing about next steps.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
